_meta.notes: Derived from the current data/ snapshots. Status categories: ok, manual, degraded, setup_required, failed.

wfp_hungermap.label: WFP HungerMap LIVE
wfp_hungermap.reason: serving a fallback tier, not the primary source
wfp_hungermap.notes: fcs_pct = % population with poor/borderline food consumption (from fcs fraction). ipc_phase3plus_pct = % in IPC Phase 3+. alerts = boolean flags from WFP HungerMap. Parsed 56 countries; fcs_pct present on 0, ipc_phase3plus_pct on 56. DEGRADED: the public FCS endpoints are unavailable, so this build carries the IPC layer only and the nowcast's wfp_pressure signal contributes 0 for every country. Not fabricated — absent, and declared absent.

wfp_country.label: Per-country FX shock + child nutrition (derived)
wfp_country.notes: Per-country FX 90d change vs USD, headline CPI, child wasting/stunting. REBUILT FROM LIVE FEEDS: WFP closed its HungerMap v2 API to anonymous clients (every /v2/ path now refuses unauthenticated requests), so this is no longer a WFP mirror. fx_currency_shock = local currency fell >10% vs USD in 90d. food_inflation_pct is null by design — no live per-country FOOD inflation source exists here, and the frontend falls back to Eurostat/FAOSTAT/WB with an explicit label rather than presenting all-items CPI as food inflation. Covered 192 of 195 countries (155 FX, 155 nutrition).

ipc.label: IPC via HungerMap mirror
ipc.notes: Phase 3 = Crisis, Phase 4 = Emergency, Phase 5 = Catastrophe/Famine. PSE is synthesised: the feed keys Gaza (PSG) and the West Bank (PSW) separately, and every consumer here looks up PSE. Covered 57 countries.

worldbank_wdi.label: World Bank WDI
worldbank_wdi.notes: Most-recent-value per indicator per country. Indicator codes per WDI metadata.

worldbank_pink_sheet.label: World Bank Pink Sheet
worldbank_pink_sheet.source: World Bank Commodity Markets Pink Sheet (https://thedocs.worldbank.org/en/doc/74e8be41ceb20fa0da750cda2f6b9e4e-0050012026/related/CMO-Historical-Data-Monthly.xlsx)
worldbank_pink_sheet.notes: Monthly nominal USD benchmark prices parsed from the World Bank Pink Sheet historical workbook. Used for commodity cards and live market benchmarks.

fao_ffpi.label: FAO Food Price Index
fao_ffpi.notes: Freshest official monthly nominal FFPI CSV resolved from the FAO Food Price Index page; legacy fallback retained only if newer source is unavailable.

eurostat_food.label: Eurostat food HICP
eurostat_food.notes: Annual rate of change in food + non-alcoholic beverages CPI per EU member state. inflation_shock = food HICP > 8.0% (lower EU threshold). Covered 30 countries.

faostat_food.label: FAOSTAT food CPI
faostat_food.source: FAOSTAT CP bulk (bulks-faostat.fao.org, Food Indices element, annual)
faostat_food.notes: Consumer Prices Food Index (2015=100), annual average. food_cpi_yoy_pct = % change vs prior year. inflation_shock = >15% YoY. Covered 162 countries.

reliefweb_alerts.label: ReliefWeb
reliefweb_alerts.source: ReliefWeb v2 (api.reliefweb.int) — appname=vreeken-foodshield-7k3n — theme: Food and Nutrition

acled.label: ACLED
acled.notes: STRUCTURAL conflict baseline — this myACLED tier is restricted to data ≥12 months old, so events are a 12-month window ending 2025-09-01 (NOT live). Feeds the FDRS conflict/logistics component as a structural signal only; is_live=false so the frontend must exclude it from the Live Disturbances feed. Covered 172 countries from 200000 events (2024-09-01→2025-09-01). Intensity = events ÷ 6000 cap × 100.

comtrade_staples.label: UN Comtrade Plus
comtrade_staples.notes: Top 5 suppliers per importer-commodity. ~25 priority importers (free-tier quota). Succeeded: 290/290, re-queued: 29, skipped: 0. Coverage this run: 19 importers / 189 importer-commodity pairs (previous file: 19 / 189). Rate-limited (429) calls are re-queued up to 3 times rather than dropped, and a coverage regression caused by failed calls keeps the previous file instead of overwriting it. v45: values count Comtrade aggregate rows only (motCode=0 AND partner2Code=0). The public-preview endpoint also returns per-transport-mode and per-second-partner copies of the same trade; summing all rows overstated USD totals for a subset of importers by ~3-11x (GBR 4.00x, DEU 3.05x, ESP ~11x; EGY/ITA/NLD were unaffected). Dropped 18195 breakout rows this run. Values are raw USD despite the legacy usd_m / total_usd_m field names.

feeding_america_states.label: Feeding America
feeding_america_states.source: Feeding America — Map the Meal Gap 2025 release (data year 2023, published May 14, 2025)
feeding_america_states.notes: Next release scheduled late July 2026 (will contain data year 2024). Source: https://www.feedingamerica.org/research/map-the-meal-gap/overall-executive-summary. Provenance class: MANUAL (hand-maintained from annual public release).

openmeteo.label: Open-Meteo Weather
openmeteo.notes: Past-14-day weather summary per country capital. precip_anomaly_pct compares 7d vs 30d normalised total. Flags: drought=anomaly<-50% + dry soil; wet=anomaly>+100%; heat=temp_anom>+3°C. Covered 195/195 countries in 2 batched request(s).

openmeteo_flood.label: Open-Meteo Flood
openmeteo_flood.notes: River discharge anomalies for 30 flood-exposed countries. flood_flag = 7d mean discharge >+75% vs 30d baseline.

usgs_water.label: USGS Water Services
usgs_water.notes: Instantaneous gage height + 7d discharge change for 17 major US river gages. flow_anomaly: low=<-25% drop (drought signal), high=>+50% rise (flood signal).

openaq.label: OpenAQ
openaq.notes: Country-level MEDIAN of latest PM2.5 station readings, restricted to readings from the last 48h. pm25_flag = country median above WHO interim target-2 (35 µg/m³). Covered 117 countries from 10965 sensor readings across 20027 mapped locations; 9 flagged.

wb_wfso.label: World Bank WFSO (Food Security Outlook)
wb_wfso.source: World Bank — World Food Security Outlook (microdata.worldbank.org/api/tables/data/fcv/wfso)
wb_wfso.notes: Quarterly food-security outlook. Source covers 1999 onward; this file stores the 3 most recent observed rows per indicator plus flattened latest_* fields and the full baseline+downside projection block — the earlier history is dropped because no consumer reads it. Methodology: Andrée et al. (2020). Covered 191 countries × up to 8 indicators. Crisis-Affected Population numbers represent IPC/CH Phase 3+ populations (3-year centered average, smoothed).

net_food_trade.label: FAOSTAT TCL net food trade
net_food_trade.notes: Net agri-food trade balance per country in millions USD. Positive = net exporter, negative = net importer. 'Food, Total' aggregate preferred; 'Agricultural Products, Total' used as fallback. Matching is name-first (code-tolerant) to survive FAOSTAT item-code drift. Covered 185 of 180 mapped countries. Most-recent year per country where both export and import values are populated and not flagged as missing.

worldbank_bulk.label: World Bank WDI bulk (22 indicators)
worldbank_bulk.notes: 22 indicators × ~206 countries. Most-recent non-null year per (country, indicator). Source refreshes quarterly upstream (Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct); we re-download every 6h but the file rarely changes between WB releases. ISO3-only — WB aggregates (WLD, EUU, HIC, etc.) are filtered out.

fx_rates.label: FX rates (ER-API + ECB Frankfurter)
fx_rates.notes: USD->local quotes; increase = local-currency depreciation. structural.depr_12m_pct = slow fragility LEVEL (feeds FDRS Economic Access); shock.depr_90d_pct = fast event DELTA (feeds nowcast FX signal). History self-accumulated from daily er-api snapshots + Frankfurter bootstrap. _ccy_history is the internal rolling store, not for display.

usda_psd.label: USDA PSD staples (wheat/rice/corn/soybeans)
usda_psd.notes: Observed production / imports / exports / consumption / stocks per country per staple per marketing year. Latest marketing year per (country, commodity, attribute). Values in 1000 metric tonnes. Commodities: wheat, rice (milled), corn, soybeans. 152 countries covered; imports captured for 152, exports for 152. Source refreshes monthly on WASDE release day; cron pulls every 6h but upstream data rarely changes between WASDE windows. Rows more than two marketing years behind the file's latest carry quality_flag 'stale' with a reason — mostly EU member states, which PSD folds into its EU aggregate and stops reporting individually.

ndgain.label: ND-GAIN climate vulnerability + readiness
ndgain.notes: TIER 1 — raw ND-GAIN release, latest year 2024. Annual climate vulnerability + readiness scores per country. Vulnerability: 0-1, higher = more vulnerable (NOT inverted). Readiness: 0-1, higher = more resilient. ND-GAIN composite: 0-100, higher = better adapted. Food sector sub-score (food_vulnerability) directly feeds the FDRS climate component. Covered 192 countries (per-metric: {'gain_index': 190, 'vulnerability': 190, 'readiness': 192, 'food_vulnerability': 189}). Source refreshes annually (typically Q3/Q4); pipeline runs every 6h but data rarely changes between releases.

aqueduct.label: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 water risk
aqueduct.notes: Country water-risk scores from WRI Aqueduct 4.0 via the World Bank Data360 mirror (WRI's own S3/GitHub CSVs are permanently offline). Three indicators, 0-5 scale, SCORE rows only — RANK and RISK_CAT share the same value column and are excluded. Coverage: water_stress 164, drought_risk 138, flood_risk 164 countries. Aggregation weight is total water withdrawal where published, population-weighted for riverine flood (the only weight it carries). Baseline reflects 1979-2019 hydrology — structural, not current-season. Coastal flood and water depletion remain absent from this mirror.

gdacs.label: GDACS hazard alerts (drought/flood/cyclone)
gdacs.source: GDACS (Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System, JRC/UN)
gdacs.notes: Live hazard events from the keyless GDACS event API, one row per event. Included: DR (Drought), FL (Flood), TC (Tropical Cyclone) — the hazard classes that move food security directly, through lost production (drought), drowned crops and cut feeder roads (flood), and flattened pre-harvest crops and closed ports (tropical cyclone). Omitted: EQ (Earthquake), WF (Wildfire), VO (Volcano) — earthquake is available behind FOODSHIELD_GDACS_TYPES but is off by default because its food impact runs through logistics already covered by LPI and the trade layers, and it is frequent enough to swamp the map; wildfire measures burned forest hectares, a poor cropland proxy, and remains a genuine coverage gap left by the dead NASA FIRMS feed. Alert levels Orange and Red only — GDACS Green means no significant impact expected and outnumbers the rest ~15:1. Window: events whose end date falls within the last 90 days, or which have not ended. is_current is derived here from the event dates (end date not more than 7 days past, or still in the future), NOT from GDACS's own iscurrent flag, which means 'in the live homepage feed' and reads false for droughts that are running today; their flag is preserved as gdacs_iscurrent. severity_score (0-100) is a rendering weight derived from the GDACS alert band, the only cross-hazard-comparable figure in the feed; the raw severity_value carries incompatible units per type (km2 for drought, magnitude for quake, km/h for cyclone, hectares for fire, and nothing at all for flood) and must never be compared across types. population_affected is null on every row: GDACS publishes no consistent affected-population figure in this API — the Sendai records mix 'out of contact' and 'rescued' counts into the 'affected' tag and the RSS population field mixes deaths, displaced and shaking-intensity exposure — so no number is published rather than an invented one. Counts: DR=5, FL=6, TC=5. 8 current.

asap.label: JRC ASAP crop-stress hotspots
asap.source: JRC ASAP (Anomaly hot Spots of Agricultural Production)
asap.notes: Current-season agricultural stress from the EC Joint Research Centre's ASAP monthly expert assessment. Latest assessment per country from the full 2016-present series; most recent date in this run 2026-07-11. hotspot_code: 0 no hotspot, 1 hotspot, 2 major hotspot. ASAP's raw hs_code 3 means NOT ASSESSED, not a severity above 2 — those countries (8 in this run) carry hotspot_code null and stress_score null. NULL IS NOT ZERO: no assessment is not an all-clear, and several unassessed countries have dozens of subnational crop warnings standing (units_crop_warning is populated regardless of code). stress_score 0-100 is banded by the JRC verdict (0-20 / 40-70 / 75-100 for codes 0/1/2) and spread within band by units_crop_warning normalised against that country's own historical maximum — so the expert verdict always dominates the ranking and the count only breaks ties. COVERAGE IS NOT GLOBAL: ASAP monitors 81 food-insecure countries only. A country absent from this payload is one ASAP does not watch (USA, Ukraine, Brazil, India, Australia among them) — absence must NOT be presented as an absence of stress. Unlike Aqueduct baseline and CCKP normals, this is a current-season signal and goes stale monthly; ASAP publishes around the 10th.

hapi_conflict.label: ACLED conflict events (HDX HAPI)
hapi_conflict.notes: Rolling 90-day conflict events and fatalities per country, from ACLED via the OCHA HDX HAPI conflict-events endpoint (start_date=2026-06-03). Buckets are calendar-monthly and the newest month is IN PROGRESS, so its counts will rise on the next refresh; the window is the calendar months overlapping the last 90 days, not an exact 90-day slice. Admin levels partition the world — admin2 24 countries, admin0 218 countries, total 242 — and per country only the finest level with rows is counted, never summed across levels. intensity_score = min(100, 25*log10(1+fatalities_90d)); 100 at 10,000 fatalities/90d. is_live=true: this is a current-quarter observation, not an annual index. ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED); acleddata.com, redistributed by OCHA HDX under ACLED terms.

rtfp.label: World Bank Real-Time Food Prices
rtfp.source: World Bank Real-Time Food Prices (RTFP) via HDX
rtfp.notes: Year-on-year food price inflation from the World Bank Real-Time Food Prices index, distributed via HDX (CC BY 4.0). One row per country: the MEDIAN of inflation_food_price_index across that country's markets at that country's own latest reporting month — median, not mean, because market-level price series carry outliers a single blown-out market must not be allowed to set. Every row's as_of is a real date read from the source's DATES column. Coverage is 37 crisis-exposed countries (as_of 2026-08-01). This does NOT replace FAOSTAT globally — FAOSTAT still carries the other ~125 countries, and RTFP is simply the better source where it exists. RTFP is a market-basket price index, not a national CPI food component: it is measured where humanitarian monitoring runs, so it reflects the markets poor households actually buy in, and it is not directly comparable with a FAOSTAT consumer price index.

portwatch.label: IMF PortWatch chokepoint transits
portwatch.notes: Daily AIS-derived transit counts for 28 maritime chokepoints. Each row is the mean transits/day over the 28 days ending 2026-08-23 (2026-07-27..2026-08-23), compared with the SAME calendar window one year earlier (2025-07-27..2025-08-23) — a calendar baseline, not a rolling average, because shipping seasonality is real. PortWatch publishes with a lag; this run is 9 days behind. Status: collapsed = total down >=50% YoY; disrupted = total down >=10% or any of dry bulk / tanker / container down >=25%; else normal. Chokepoints averaging under 1 transits/day in the baseline are never flagged (percentage change on near-zero traffic is noise) and carry low_volume=true. Counts are transits, not tonnage or cargo value. Source: IMF PortWatch (portwatch.imf.org), redistributed with attribution under IMF terms.

faostat_import_dep.label: FAOSTAT cereal import dependency
faostat_import_dep.source: FAOSTAT Food Balance Sheets bulk download
faostat_import_dep.notes: Cereal import dependency ratio: cereal imports as a share of cereal domestic supply, per FAO's own definition, across wheat, rice and maize. Replaces the hand-authored FDRS c[0] literal, which carried weight 0.23 with no source and no data year. Clamped to 0-100 — re-exporting entrepots can post imports above domestic supply. Covered 177 countries.

faostat_prod_index.label: FAOSTAT gross food production index
faostat_prod_index.notes: Per-country food production trend from FAOSTAT's Gross Production Index (Food, 2014-2016 = 100). Replaces the hand-authored FDRS c[2] literal, which carried weight 0.11 with no source and no data year. Falling production scores high. Countries with fewer than 5 index points in the window carry a null score and quality_flag 'partial' — never 0. Covered 185 countries, 185 scored.

inform_risk.label: EU JRC INFORM Risk Index
inform_risk.notes: Composite humanitarian risk 0-10 + 3 dimensions (Hazard & Exposure, Vulnerability, Lack of Coping Capacity). Parsed from the official 2026 workbook committed at scripts/vendor_data/INFORM_Risk_2026_v072.xlsx (JRC dropped the stable download URL). Covered 191 countries. Higher = greater risk. Update annually when JRC publishes a new edition.

wgi.label: WB Worldwide Governance Indicators
wgi.source: World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators (WB Data360, WB_WGI)
wgi.notes: 6 governance dimensions per country, latest year, -2.5..+2.5 estimate (COMP_BREAKDOWN_1=WGI_EST; percentile-rank and std-error variants excluded). v25: pulled from WB Data360 because the WB v2 API archived the bare *.EST codes. Covered 215 countries.

daily_summary.label: FoodShield daily 'what changed' summary
daily_summary.source: FoodShield daily summary (composite of nowcast + IPC + FFPI + Open-Meteo + INFORM)
daily_summary.notes: Deterministic text built from actual signal deltas. No LLM. Regenerates every workflow tick (6h). Surfaced at the top of the Disturbances tab.

lpi.label: WB Logistics Performance Index
lpi.notes: 7 logistics dimensions per country, latest year per indicator. Score range 1 (worst) to 5 (best). Biennial release; latest 2023 (WB skipped 2020 and 2022 due to COVID). Covered 181 countries.

hdi.label: UNDP Human Development Index
hdi.notes: Annual human-development composite + sub-indices per country. HDI score 0-1 (higher = better). Latest year populated per series. Covered 195 countries. Series: HDI, Life expectancy, Expected/Mean years of schooling, GNI per capita, Gender Inequality, Inequality-adjusted HDI, Coefficient of human inequality, Planetary-pressures HDI.

cckp.label: WB Climate Change Knowledge Portal
cckp.source: World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal (WB Data360, WB_CCKP)
cckp.notes: Observed per-country climate from WB Data360 (database WB_CCKP): mean annual temperature (TAS, °C) and total annual precipitation (PR, mm), annual series. We report the 1991-2020 baseline mean, the most-recent-10-year mean, observed warming (°C), and precipitation change (%). v24: switched from the cckpapi projection endpoints (which returned empty) to the Data360 observed series — more reliable and observed, not modeled. Covered 238 countries.

fews.label: FEWS NET IPC Outlook (live FDW API)
fews.source: FEWS NET FDW · IPC-style phase classifications (fdw.fews.net/api/ipcphase/)
fews.notes: auth_mode=public/unauthenticated. Country-level worst-phase summary across admin-2 units, with current (CS) + 3-month (ML1) + 6-month (ML2) projections where available. Covered 28 of 35 FEWS countries. Phases: 1=Minimal, 2=Stressed, 3=Crisis, 4=Emergency, 5=Famine.

commodity_flows.label: Trade Flow Atlas — curated bilateral corridors (static snapshot)
commodity_flows.reason: static atlas snapshot, rebuilt by hand — cut 2026-06-04
commodity_flows.source: RaboResearch World Beef Map 2025 + USDA FAS PSD + ABIEC + ITC + UN Comtrade (Beefmap dataset)

commodity_news.label: Commodity news (GDELT DOC 2.0 + EC agriculture RSS)
commodity_news.notes: Third-party headlines only. Every item is a CLAIM by its publisher, not measured data — quality_flag='claim' on all items. Commodity AND country attribution are MODELED (our keyword match against the headline), never sourced; corridor TONNAGES are sourced from commodity_flows.json. Those two are different kinds of claim and the UI must not blur them: a modeled country match pointing at a sourced tonnage is still a modeled claim about relevance. Exposure means a headline TOUCHES a corridor — no causal claim is made about prices. Headlines are stored verbatim with a link; no article body, summary, snippet or image is stored. Relevance, publisher-trust and recency scores are internal ranking inputs and are deliberately not published. Sources are the publishers' own syndication feeds — no search-engine aggregator. No Google News: its feed terms forbid this use. No WTO: its robots.txt disallows all non-Google automated fetching. SOURCE HEALTH: 51 of 53 publisher feeds returned data; 2 FAILED (ok): Farmers Weekly SA, ReliefWeb. A headline count cannot show this — one working feed still fills the page — so the ratio is reported explicitly. Corridor attribution ACTIVE: 32 of 106 items joined.
